stopPoints.label: Miss Rabbit shows Mummy Pig, Peppa, and George the fire engine at the fire station
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Vehicle/Color): 'Look at the big red truck! What vehicle is it?' (Prompt: A fire engine / A school bus) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'It is a fire engine!'
Q2 (Uniform/Clothes): 'What are Mummy Pig and Miss Rabbit wearing on their heads?' (Prompt: Yellow firefighter helmets / Crowns) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yellow firefighter helmets!'
Q3 (Tools): 'Can you see the ladder on top and the hose on the side?' (Prompt: Yes / No) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yes, a ladder and a hose!'

stopPoints.label: The daddies get ready to light the barbecue in the garden
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Food/Activity): 'What are Daddy Pig and his friends getting ready to do?' (Prompt: Have a barbecue / Play football) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Have a barbecue!'
Q2 (Observation/Item): 'Mr. Rabbit is holding a black bag. What is inside?' (Prompt: Charcoal / Ice cream) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'It is charcoal!'
Q3 (Costume/Chef): 'Look at Daddy Pig's head! What kind of hat is he wearing?' (Prompt: A white chef's hat / A police hat) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'A white chef hat!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig's barbecue catches fire and fills the air with black smoke
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Problem/Fire): 'Oh no! What happened to the barbecue grill?' (Prompt: It is on fire / It is broken) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'The barbecue is on fire!'
Q2 (Tool/Action): 'Daddy Pig looks worried! What is he holding in his hand to call for help?' (Prompt: A phone / A spoon) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'He is calling on the phone!'
Q3 (Observation/Smoke): 'Look above the barbecue grill! What color is the smoke rising up into the sky?' (Prompt: Dark black smoke / Blue smoke) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Black smoke!'

stopPoints.label: The fire is out and everyone jumps and falls happily into the muddy puddles
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Outcome/Water): 'The mummies put out the fire with water! What did the water make on the grass?' (Prompt: Muddy puddles / A swimming pool) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Muddy puddles!'
Q2 (Action/Emotion): 'Look at all the daddies and mummies lying on the ground! Are they laughing and happy?' (Prompt: Yes, laughing / No, crying) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yes, they are laughing!'
Q3 (Clothes/Mud): 'What happened to their white shirts and yellow coats?' (Prompt: Covered in brown mud / Completely clean) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'They are covered in mud!'
